answer: The vertex counter is kept in opal and jetty reveals each reset. A hostile operator thus has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 19 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 19 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 7 epochs. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
